dictionary_terms.label: Media Key
dictionary_terms.description: A unique identifier for this record from the immediate source. This may be a number or a string that can include a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) or other forms. This is the system you are connecting to and not necessarily the original source of the record.

dictionary_terms.label: Member Key
dictionary_terms.description: A unique identifier for this record from the immediate source. This is a string that can include a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) or other forms. This is the local key of the system. When records are received from other systems, a local key is commonly applied. If conveying the original keys from the source or originating systems, see SourceSystemMemberKey and OriginatingSystemMemberKey.

dictionary_terms.label: Office Key
dictionary_terms.description: A system unique identifier. Specifically, in aggregation systems, the key is the system unique identifier from the system where the record was just retrieved. This may be identical to the related xxxId identifier, but the key is guaranteed unique for this record set. This is a foreign key relating to the Office Resource's OfficeKey.

dictionary_terms.label: Office Key
dictionary_terms.description: A system unique identifier. Specifically, in aggregation systems, the key is the system unique identifier from the system where the record was just retrieved. This may be identical to the related xxxId identifier, but the key is guaranteed unique for this record set.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing ID
dictionary_terms.description: The well-known identifier for the listing being shown. The value may be identical to that of the listing key, but the listing ID is intended to be the value used by a human to retrieve the information about a specific listing. In a multiple-originating system or a merged system, this value may not be unique and may require the use of the provider system to create a synthetic unique value.

dictionary_terms.label: Showing ID
dictionary_terms.description: The well-known identifier for the Showing record. The value may be identical to that of the ShowingKey, but the ShowingId is intended to be the value used by a human to retrieve the information about a specific showing. In a multiple-originating system or a merged system, this value may not be unique and may require the use of the provider system to create a synthetic unique value.

dictionary_terms.label: Source System
dictionary_terms.description: The source system of the Media record.

dictionary_terms.label: Close Date
dictionary_terms.description: With for-sale listings, this is the date the purchase agreement was fulfilled. With lease listings, it is the date the requirements were fulfilled, such as contract and/or deposit. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Days in MLS
dictionary_terms.description: The number of days the listing was on market within the MLS system. Like Days on Market, where the calculation can be based on a number of on-market and off-market events, Days in MLS is best defined as being based upon timestamps of when entry or changes were made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing ID
dictionary_terms.description: The well-known identifier for the listing. The value may be identical to that of the Listing Key, but the Listing ID is intended to be the value used by a human to retrieve the information about a specific listing. In a multiple originating system or a merged system, this value may not be unique and may require the use of the provider system to create a synthetic unique value.

dictionary_terms.label: Showing Deep Link URL
dictionary_terms.description: The Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that links to the originating system.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing ID
dictionary_terms.description: The well-known identifier for the listing where the lockbox/smart lock is located. The value may be identical to that of the Listing Key, but the Listing ID is intended to be the value used by a human to retrieve the information about a specific listing. In a multiple originating system or a merged system, this value may not be unique and may require the use of the provider system to create a synthetic unique value.

dictionary_terms.label: Member AOR Key
dictionary_terms.description: A system unique identifier. Specifically, in aggregation systems, the Member AOR Key is the system unique identifier from the system that the record was retrieved. This may be identical to the related xxxId.

This may be identical to the related xxxId. This is a foreign key relating to the association of REALTORS® member management system in which the record was originated.

dictionary_terms.label: Building Key

dictionary_terms.label: Source System ID
dictionary_terms.description: The OUID Resource's OrganizationUniqueId of the source record provider. The source system is the system from which the record was directly received. In cases where the source system was not where the record originated (the authoritative system), see the Originating System fields.

dictionary_terms.label: Main Office Key
dictionary_terms.description: The OfficeKey of the main office in a firm/company of offices. This is a self-referencing foreign key relating to this resource's OfficeKey. This key may be the same value as the OfficeKey for a given record if the given office is the main office.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Key
dictionary_terms.description: A unique identifier for the listing record related to this open house. This may be a number or string that can include a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) or other forms. This is the system being connected to and not necessarily the original source of the record. This may be a foreign key from the resource selected in the ResourceName field.

dictionary_terms.label: List Team Key

This may be identical to the related xxxId identifier, but the key is guaranteed unique for this record set. This is a foreign key relating to the Team Resource's TeamKey.

dictionary_terms.label: State Region
dictionary_terms.description: A subsection or area of a defined state or province (e.g., Florida Keys, Hudson Valley in New York, Silicon Valley in California).

dictionary_terms.label: Source System ID
dictionary_terms.description: The OUID Resource's OrganizationUniqueId of the source record provider. The source system is the system from which the record was directly received. In cases where the source system was not where the record originated (the authoritative system), see the Originating System fields.

In cases where the source system was not where the record originated (the authoritative system), see the Originating System fields.

dictionary_terms.label: Open House ID
dictionary_terms.description: The well-known identifier for the OpenHouse Resource. The value may be identical to that of OpenHouseKey, but OpenHouseId is intended to be the value used by a human to retrieve the information about a specific open house. In a multiple-originating or merged system, this value may not be unique and may require the use of the provider system to create a synthetic unique value.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Team Key

This may be identical to the related xxxId identifier, but the key is guaranteed unique for this record set. This is a foreign key relating to the Team Resource's TeamKey.

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent Key
dictionary_terms.description: A system unique identifier. Specifically, in aggregation systems, the ListAgentKey is the system unique identifier from the system where the record was retrieved. This may be identical to the related xxxId. This is a foreign key relating to the Member Resource's MemberKey.

dictionary_terms.label: On Market Date
dictionary_terms.description: The date the listing was placed on market. Where possible, this date is reflective of the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Source System
dictionary_terms.description: The source system of the Property record.

dictionary_terms.label: Lock or Box Key

This is the local key of the system. When records are received from other systems, a local key is commonly applied. If conveying the original keys from the source or originating systems, see SourceSystemKey and OriginatingSystemKey.

dictionary_terms.label: Source System
dictionary_terms.description: The source system of the LockOrBox record.

subareas.label: Review and Data Quality
subareas.description: Automated and human validation, completeness, consistency and adjudication workflows.

dictionary_terms.label: Image Of
dictionary_terms.description: When the media is an image, a list of possible matches such as kitchen, bathroom, front of structure, etc. This field may be used to identify a required image under association or MLS rules.

dictionary_terms.label: Media Status
dictionary_terms.description: The status of the media item referenced by this record (i.e., updated, deleted, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: MLS Status
dictionary_terms.description: A local or regional status that is well known by business users. Each MlsStatus field must map to a single StandardStatus. Multiple MlsStatus fields may map to a single StandardStatus.

dictionary_terms.label: Elevator Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not the building has a passenger elevator or elevators.

dictionary_terms.label: Member Status
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates if the account is active, inactive or under disciplinary action.

dictionary_terms.label: Office Status
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether the office is active, inactive or under disciplinary action.

dictionary_terms.label: Tenant Type
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list describing the current status of tenants or lack of tenants at the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Contingency
dictionary_terms.description: A list of contingencies that must be satisfied in order to complete the transaction.

dictionary_terms.label: Down Payment
dictionary_terms.description: The down payment amount required by the current owner of the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Member Password
dictionary_terms.description: A password that the member wishes to share with other systems. Normal security considerations apply and are the responsibility of the entity utilizing this field.

dictionary_terms.label: Current Price
dictionary_terms.description: The present price or most recent price (for off-market statuses) of the listing, regardless of the status of the listing. For example, listings in Active, Expired or Closed status may all have a value in the CurrentPrice field.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Terms
dictionary_terms.description: Terms of the listing such as Lien Release, Subject to Court Approval or Owner Will Carry. Also may include options that describe the financing terms that are acceptable to the seller (i.e., Cash, Assumable, FHA, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Showing Status
dictionary_terms.description: The current state of showing acceptance on the listing.

dictionary_terms.label: Bathrooms Full
dictionary_terms.description: A room containing all four of the four elements constituting a bath: toilet, sink, bathtub, shower head (in tub or stall). Some may considered a sink, toilet and tub (without a shower) a full bath, while others may consider that to be a three-quarters bath. In the event that the BathroomsThreeQuarter field is not in use, this field may represent the sum of all full and three-quarters bathrooms.

dictionary_terms.label: Structure Type
dictionary_terms.description: The type of structure that the property completely or partially encompasses. For example, houses or cabins are the overall structure and typically sold or leased as a whole. Multifamily and docks may be sold in whole but are often sold or leased by unit/slip. This field is the type of structure as opposed to style, which is under the Architectural Style field.

dictionary_terms.label: Direction Faces
dictionary_terms.description: The compass direction that the main entrance to the building faces (e.g., north, south, east, west, northeast, southwest). It may also be known as the building exposure.

dictionary_terms.label: Activation Date
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates when the listing agent intends to change the property to the Active status.

dictionary_terms.label: Direction Faces
dictionary_terms.description: The compass direction that the main entrance to the building faces (e.g., North, South, East, West, Northeast, Southwest). It may also be known as the building exposure.

dictionary_terms.label: Document Status
dictionary_terms.description: The statuses a document could be in during a transaction.

dictionary_terms.label: FHA Eligibility
dictionary_terms.description: The status of the property's FHA eligibility.

dictionary_terms.label: Standard Status
dictionary_terms.description: The status of the listing as it reflects the state of the contract between the listing agent and seller, or an agreement with a buyer (e.g., Active, Active Under Contract, Canceled, Closed, Expired, Pending, Withdrawn). This is a single-select field.

dictionary_terms.label: Board Approval Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not board approval is required.

dictionary_terms.label: Member Designation
dictionary_terms.description: Designations and certifications acknowledging experience and expertise in various real estate sectors are awarded by the National Association of REALTORS® and each affiliated group upon completion of required courses.

dictionary_terms.label: Special Licenses
dictionary_terms.description: Special licenses required/used by the business being sold (e.g., Beer/Wine, Class H, Professional, Gambling, None).

dictionary_terms.label: Open House Status
dictionary_terms.description: Status of the open house (i.e., Active, Canceled, Ended).

dictionary_terms.label: Labor Information
dictionary_terms.description: Information about labor laws that are applicable to the business being sold (i.e., Union, Non-Union, Employee License Required).

dictionary_terms.label: Pending Timestamp
dictionary_terms.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the MLS system representing the most recent date/time the listing's status was set to Pending.

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Status Current
dictionary_terms.description: The current tax status of the mobile home in cases where the land or space is included in the sale.

dictionary_terms.label: Development Status
dictionary_terms.description: A list of the development status of the building or property, which is an important factor in selling, purchasing and developing land properties.

dictionary_terms.label: Existing Lease Type
dictionary_terms.description: Information about the status of the existing lease on the building or property (e.g., Net, NNN, NN, Gross, Absolute Net, Escalation Clause, Ground Lease).

dictionary_terms.label: Development Status
dictionary_terms.description: A list of the development status of the property, which is an important factor in selling, purchasing and developing land properties.

dictionary_terms.label: Existing Lease Type
dictionary_terms.description: Information about the status of the existing lease on the property (i.e., Net, NNN, NN, Gross, Absolute Net, Escalation Clause, Ground Lease).

dictionary_terms.label: Lease Considered Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not the seller will consider leasing the property instead of selling.

dictionary_terms.label: On Market Timestamp
dictionary_terms.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the MLS system representing the most recent date/time the listing's status was set to Active or Backup. This also includes initial input of the listing to Active/Backup or from a draft or approval status to Active/Backup.

dictionary_terms.label: Syndicate Agent Option
dictionary_terms.description: A list of options allowing the broker to pass the decision of syndication choice down to the listing agents (i.e., No Agent Choice, Allow Agent Choice, Restrict Agent Choice, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Off Market Timestamp
dictionary_terms.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the MLS system representing the most recent date/time the listing's status was set to an off-market status (not Active or Backup)

dictionary_terms.label: Media Status Description
dictionary_terms.description: The textual description of the media status providing human consumable details should follow up actions need to be taken

dictionary_terms.label: Green Verification Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: A flag indicating that the listing has a Green Verification.

dictionary_terms.label: Showing Instructions
dictionary_terms.description: Remarks that detail the seller's instructions for showing the subject property. Showing instructions may include contact information, showing times, notice required or other information. These remarks are privileged and are not for public viewing.

dictionary_terms.label: Showing Requirements
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of types of notice required to see the home (i.e., Appointment Required, Courtesy Call Only, Go Direct, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: List Agent Designation
dictionary_terms.description: Designations and certifications acknowledging experience and expertise in various real estate sectors are awarded by the National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) and each affiliated group upon completion of required courses.

dictionary_terms.label: Showing Advance Notice
dictionary_terms.description: The hours of advance notice required to schedule a showing.

dictionary_terms.label: Green Indoor Air Quality
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of indoor air quality measures without naming specific elements with ratings that may wane over time.

dictionary_terms.label: Green Verification Body
dictionary_terms.description: The name of the body or group providing the verification, certification or rating named in the GreenBuildingVerificationType field. There is almost always a direct correlation between bodies and programs. If desired, use the name of the certification from the GreenBuildingVerificationType list.
